text:
Nora (People Ops): brainstorming: "Recognition Ripple" — small postcard + $15 local coffee e-gift for folks recognized in Q2. want to sync on fulfillment, tax wording, and manager approval cadence. quick takes?
Ben (Logistics): love it. postcards are lightweight for intl, cheaper customs. shipping windows?
Nora (People Ops): target sends by June 10. cutoffs: managers submit approvals 6/1, ops finalize addresses 6/3, vendor fulfill 6/10.
Asha (HRBP): approval cadence ok. managers should get compact digest with names + short reason. one-click approve required.
Kory (Finance): $15 e-gift: if sent via vendor codes it's non-payroll. track in GL-6120. need forecast qty for PO.
Mika (Design): i'll drop two postcard art options — playful and minimalist. which tone?
Nora (People Ops): playful for early-career recipients, minimalist for exec-level comms. can we let manager pick style?
Ben (Logistics): courier note: postcards can go USPS/royal mail/local post depending on region. for countries with unreliable mail, we should switch to e-card only.
Leo (Vendor Coord): vendor can bulk-send e-gifts within 48 hours; physical printing partner can run postcards with a 5-business-day lead. PO required by 5/22 to hit that timeline.
Asha (HRBP): wording: avoid monetary phrasing on the postcard. include a line: "You've been recognized by your manager. Details were sent securely." Link to private e-card for amount.
Kory (Finance): confirm: if any recipient requests cash, it must go through payroll. add that to manager comms.
Mika (Design): mockups will include a tiny QR code to the e-card; ok to use?
Nora (People Ops): yes QR is good. ensure it's a secure link (auth).
Ben (Logistics): action: I'll compile the regional delivery matrix and flag countries where physical mail is discouraged (due Wed).
Leo (Vendor Coord): I'll confirm vendor PO terms and e-code delivery SLA (by Tue).
Kory (Finance): I'll provision GL-6120 and estimate cost range once you share headcount (ETA Tue).
Asha (HRBP): I'll draft manager digest + approval flow copy and share for review (by Thu).
Mika (Design): mockups by Mon EOD.
Nora (People Ops): thanks team. next steps: collect final headcount (Joan, can you export?), lock PO by 5/22, and I'll schedule a short demo of the manager approval form. ping here with blockers. :raised_hands:
